```{r}
# short block to check if the packages are installed; will download and install any that are not.
packages <- c("class", "caret", "gmodels", "e1071", "reshape2")

for (pkg in packages) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}
```

```{r}
bank <- read.csv("UniversalBank.csv")
print("Bank Dims")
dim(bank) #5000 rows, 14 cols
#strip data to reqs.
bank <- bank[, c("Online", "CreditCard", "Personal.Loan")]
#rename for ease.
names(bank) <- c("Online", "CC", "Loan")
#factors for y/n binary
bank$Online <- factor(bank$Online, levels = c(0,1))
bank$CC <- factor(bank$CC, levels = c(0,1))
bank$Loan <- factor(bank$Loan, levels = c(0,1))
#check
print("Bank Loan Table")
table(bank$Loan)
```

```{r}
#partition for training
set.seed(1234567890)
split <- sample(seq_len(nrow(bank)), size=round(0.6*nrow(bank)))
training <- bank[split,]
validation <- bank[-split,]
#check each && validate
nrow(training)
nrow(validation)
```
